title: PayPal Holdings, Inc. Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At June 30 PayPal reported USD 8.306 billion cash, USD 6.959 billion investments and USD 13.400 billion short- and long-term debt.
summary: The unchanged Q2 Form 10-Q remains current primary evidence for identity, liquidity, debt, share count and the maintained operating, credit, regulatory, cyber and execution risks.
